budget_items.topic: Grease trap and oil/water separator permit fees and penalties
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The proposed policy sets an annual permit fee, a $100 bill for non-compliance after 30 days, and a $25/day fine if still non-compliant.
budget_items.quote: $150/year for internal grease traps, external interceptor and oil/water separator.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission has not received any of the $25/day fees assessed since 11/11/22 for non-compliance.
budget_items.quote: received any of the $25/day fees that were assessed since 11/11/22 for non-compliance.
